import tarfile
import pickle

def extract_human_data(data):
    with open(data, 'rb') as f:
        h = pickle.load(f)

    member_list1 = ['name','title','info']
    info_list = []

    tar = tarfile.open(data)
    tar.extractall(path='../')
    tar.close()

    for member in tar.getmembers():
        if member.name in member_list1:
            info = tar.extract(member.name)
            info_list.append(info)

    return info_list
